    init        Configure bee: store the single Mongo connection everything else
                is pulled from                                                  
    remember    Persistent memory (decisions/errors/learnings). Bare text saves;
                'context/search/stats/history' query                            
    entity      People, organizations, projects and repos: lookup before        
                resolving a name                                                
    ask         Ask the configured model (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic). Reads

                soul; list/use/add/show/claim/remove                            
    skill       Query a skill-bridge (domain skills) over MCP. Config-driven:   
                search/list/get/resolve/categories/suggest/tools                
    steering    Which rules bee decided NOT to deliver, and why. The half       
                nothing else records                                            
    howto       Pattern/how-to store (Mongo-backed). Bare text searches;        
                get/add/list/rm manage your conventions                         
    hook        Steer the AI: emit identity + rules + memory for agent hooks;   
                manage behavioral rules                                         
    graph       Code graph of this checkout: who calls X, what breaks if Y      
                changes. Local, no Mongo                                        
    compact     Which memories are costing recall rather than adding to it.     
                Reports only                                                    
    lint        What this project expects of these files — ask BEFORE writing,  
                not at review (--json)

USAGE:

ARGUMENTS:

    -h, --help            Prints help information

        --solution                                                              
        --prevention                                                            
        --category                                                              
        --tags            Comma-separated tags                                  
        --path <GLOB>     The files this fact is about (repeatable). Anchors it:
                          'bee lint' on a matching file surfaces it             
        --session                                                               
        --json            Emit a stable machine-readable shape instead of a     
                          table                                                 
        --before          Only memories learned before this: 7d, 24h, or a date 
                          like 2026-08-01                                       
        --agent                                                                 
        --all-projects                                                          
        --semantic        Rank by embedding (cosine) similarity instead of token
                          match

DESCRIPTION:
Ask the configured model (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic). Reads stdin if no prompt —
an AI-to-AI access point

USAGE:
    bee ask [prompt] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [prompt]    The question. If omitted, bee reads the prompt from stdin

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help           Prints help information                                
        --provider       Override provider: deepseek | openai | anthropic       
    -m, --model          Override the model id                                  
    -s, --system         Optional system prompt (added on top of the active     
                         soul)                                                  
        --soul           Use a specific persona for this call instead of the    
                         active one                                             
        --no-soul        Ignore the active persona for this call                
        --tools          Let the model call bee's tools (memory/skill/config).  
                         Read tools only, unless --allow-write                  
        --allow-write    Permit write/sensitive tools (memory_save, config_get).
                         Default: denied by the gate                            
        --raw            Print only the answer (no header). Default when stdout 
                         is piped

DESCRIPTION:
What this project expects of these files — ask BEFORE writing, not at review 
(--json)

USAGE:
    bee lint [paths] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [paths]    Files you are about to write or change. Defaults to the current  
               directory                                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
        --rules                Only the project's conventions. Runs no tool,    
                               needs no toolchain                               
        --detect               Report the linter bee would run, and why, without
                               running it                                       
        --fix                  Run the tool's fix mode where it has one.        
                               Rewrites files                                   
        --install              Install the PROJECT's own dependencies if that is
                               what is missing (e.g. node_modules)              
        --install-machine      Also install a missing linter onto THIS MACHINE  
                               (e.g. swiftlint, ruff). Implies --install        
        --timeout <SECONDS>    Per-tool ceiling (default 300)                   
        --memory <N>           How many anchored memories to surface (default 5,
                               0 to skip)                                       
        --json                 Machine-readable output

                                 chars per token (default 2000; 0 = none)

        --full                   Rebuild everything and re-hash every file, even
                                 when the graph is fresh                        
        --dop <N>                Parallelism for hashing and extraction         
                                 (default: the processor count)
